_fm_render.origin: rendered by the First Motive render plane — edit the upstream source, not this file

description: Each First Motive primitive lists the tldraw light-theme colours tldraw-rebrand.cjs turns into it. Only the black, violet, yellow, and light-violet swatches (with tldraw's own neutrals) are listed, so any other swatch in an export fails the render. The values belong to the exporter pinned below, so re-read them when that pin moves. The exporter lives here, not in render.sh, so the SVG stamp (which hashes this file) goes stale when it changes.
